title: High Throughput Sequencing of SQX
description: In order to further study the diversity of microbial communities, we sequenced and analyzed the phylum, class and genus levels of the indirect extraction method. Biofilm samples included raw sludge ( C1 ), single substrate sludge ( C2 ) and co-substrate sludge ( C3 ). The microbial communities of the three sludge samples were significantly different in high-throughput sequencing analysis.
